directive.quote: For each, find what now does that job in trillion-rust or trillion-workshop, use it, and move the tool one to one under tools/.

preserve: All source algorithms and their observable ordering, validation, evidence and refusal behavior
Each caller reads only its own account observations and keeps its own row settings
No successful read or accepted dispatch is claimed as an unobserved outcome
allowed_deltas: Scope opinion settings and owner callbacks to a caller instance rather than importing content or an old Worker engine closure
Reach settings and file bytes through the current records-door and content-identity owners
Keep the operator cleanup route as an owner-wired library; the public device inspection tool writes nothing
Use current formula filtering for attention rules; no paid model call is introduced
banned_substitutions: A callback that always grants account authority
Weakening evidence, history, receipt or voice ownership checks
Changing thresholds or opinion content to make tests pass
